summary: Frontend-only E2E for iter43 self-service billing, in-app Support, Admin Audit Trail. All 7 flows pass end-to-end after a 1-line frontend fix. Found + fixed a bug where Solo users couldn't save feature toggles because the frontend was sending `seats` with the save, which the backend rejects with 400 for non-editable tiers. After fix, Plan updated toast appears and the toggle persists on reload. Firmadmin seats 5↔6 ($300↔$360) works and was reset to 5. Advisor /billing shows the no-subscription card with no seats/feature controls. Solo support ticket surfaces in /admin/tickets and status change (open→in_progress) persists after reload. Refunding a seeded paid invoice logs an audit entry visible on /admin/audit (7 rows, mentions refund). Admin→/dashboard redirects to /admin; solo→/admin redirects to /dashboard.

integration_issues.issue: FIXED by testing agent. BillingSelfService.jsx always sent {seats, features} on save; backend rejects seats on solo tier with HTTP 400 'Seats are fixed on your plan', so feature toggle never persisted and no toast fired. Change: only include seats in the PUT body when seatsEditable is true.

action_items: Review the small frontend fix in BillingSelfService.jsx (conditional seats in save payload). No other changes needed; backend behaviour is already correct and matches the spec (solo seats are FIXED).
critical_code_review_comments: BillingSelfService.jsx was coupling two independent concerns in a single save payload. Fix sends seats only when editable to match backend contract.
Consider also hiding seats from PUT when they haven't changed (idempotent save) to keep the API strict and audit-log noise down.

rca_of_the_issue: Solo plan save failed because the frontend savePlan mutation unconditionally sent {seats, features}. Backend PUT /api/me/subscription at /app/backend/routers/platform_admin.py:398 throws HTTPException 400 'Seats are fixed on your plan' when body.seats is provided for a tier with SEATS_EDITABLE=False (solo). Fix: only include seats when seatsEditable. Reproduction before fix: log in as solo → /billing → toggle any feature chip → Save plan → console shows 400, no toast, reload reverts. Verified fixed after change.
